en: Philippians 2

p.src: 1  If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

en: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
u.src: 1  If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

p.src: 2  make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

en: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
u.src: 2  make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

p.src: 3  doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

en: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
u.src: 3  doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

p.src: 4  each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

en: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
u.src: 4  each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

p.src: 5  Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

en: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
u.src: 5  Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

p.src: 6  who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

en: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,
u.src: 6  who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

p.src: 7  but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

en: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
u.src: 7  but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

p.src: 8  And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

en: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
u.src: 8  And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

p.src: 9  Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

en: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
u.src: 9  Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

p.src: 10  that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

en: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
u.src: 10  that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

p.src: 11  and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

en: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
u.src: 11  and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

p.src: 12  So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

en: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
u.src: 12  So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

p.src: 13  For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

en: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
u.src: 13  For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

p.src: 14  Do all things without complaining and arguing,

en: Do all things without complaining and arguing,
u.src: 14  Do all things without complaining and arguing,

p.src: 15  that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

en: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
u.src: 15  that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

p.src: 16  holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

en: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.
u.src: 16  holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

p.src: 17  Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

en: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.
u.src: 17  Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

p.src: 18  In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

en: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
u.src: 18  In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

p.src: 19  But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

en: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
u.src: 19  But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

p.src: 20  For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

en: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
u.src: 20  For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

p.src: 21  For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

en: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.
u.src: 21  For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

p.src: 22  But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

en: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
u.src: 22  But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

p.src: 23  Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

en: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.
u.src: 23  Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

p.src: 24  But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

en: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.
u.src: 24  But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

p.src: 25  But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

en: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
u.src: 25  But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

p.src: 26  since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

en: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
u.src: 26  since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

p.src: 27  For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

en: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.
u.src: 27  For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

p.src: 28  I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

en: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
u.src: 28  I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

p.src: 29  Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,
u.src: 29  Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

p.src: 30  because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

en: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
u.src: 30  because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
